verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API that covers realms, users, roles and clients, and the kcadm.sh Admin CLI scripts the same operations. Machine access is backed by client-credentials service accounts, built-in per-realm SCIM endpoints, a Protection API and documented OIDC endpoints with a well-known discovery document. A community user who drives the API from Ansible confirms it works but calls it inconsistent and hard to keep idempotent, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the common website paths. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable URL, independent evidence that the API behaves consistently and idempotently for automation.
